research.notes: Candidate not confirmed. No registry (CA Secretary of State, ProPublica, SAM.gov) check was possible: the web search budget for the session was exhausted and ProPublica returned HTTP 429. The website does not mention Oakland Unified, a physical address, or the owner, so it is unclear whether the contracting party is a business entity or an individual operating under this name. The 951 area code suggests Southern California. Needs manual review before any publication.

profile.summary: LCS-Training is a consulting and training firm focused on special education reporting and data management. It offers support services, consulting, training for data staff and teachers, and auditing and data analysis related to California special education data systems such as SEIS and CALPADS.
